subject: VCF Automation 9.1 - Deployment, Request, Event and Event Log operations
note: VCF Automation is not covered by the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0). No published OpenAPI/Swagger document for these operations was available, so docs/contract.json was derived by reading the authoritative xAPIs reference pages listed below.
apiReference: VCF Automation API - VM Apps Org - Deployment

pages.documents: Broadcom xAPIs index; used to locate the VCF Automation API families (VM Apps Org, All Apps Org, Provider Infrastructure) and to confirm no VCF Automation OpenAPI specification is published alongside them.
Full REST operation index for the VM Apps Org - Deployment API; used to enumerate the deployment/request/event/log operation set and their exact path templates.
Method, path, complete query parameter list and paged response shape.
Method, path, path parameter, query parameters (including page/size/sort and the OData-style $top/$skip/$orderby) and the paged Request response shape.
Method, path, ResourceActionRequest request body (all three fields optional) and the Request response body.
Method, path, absence of query parameters, and the Request response fields including the status enumeration.
Method, path, page/size/sort query parameters and the PageEvent response shape including the Event fields (id, name, details, timestamp, resourceType, resourceName, hasLogs, userEvent).
Method, path, the sinceRow query parameter and the SliceEventLog response shape including EventLog fields (id, message, rownum, timestamp, eof).

Deployment structure field list and the verbatim status enumeration (CREATE_SUCCESSFUL, CREATE_INPROGRESS, CREATE_FAILED, UPDATE_SUCCESSFUL, UPDATE_INPROGRESS, UPDATE_FAILED, DELETE_SUCCESSFUL, DELETE_INPROGRESS, DELETE_FAILED).

ResourceActionRequest structure: actionId (optional), inputs (optional), reason (optional). This is the request body of Submit Deployment Action Request and is the basis for the wire-shape rule that unsupplied optional fields are omitted.

relatedButNotUsed.reason: Provider Infrastructure APIs are a separate VCF Automation surface that versions via an Accept header (application/json;version=9.1.0). The VM Apps Org - Deployment operations used here do not, so this reference is recorded for context only.

Dependency manifest for VCF PowerCLI 9.1. Confirms the VMware.Sdk.Vcf family ships bindings for CloudBuilder, SddcManager, Installer and Ops only - there is no generated VCF Automation binding, which is why the deployment triage calls in this task are hand-rolled REST against the reference-derived contract.
